title: tld bulk import
description: Atomic upsert. Omitted resources are kept. Connector identity is view/source/target/label; changing it creates another connector. Connector tags are not supported by the batch API; use tld update connector.

elementRef.description: Element reference matching a key in elements.yaml. Must start with a lowercase letter or digit and may contain lowercase letters, digits, dots, underscores, and hyphens. `root` is reserved and cannot be used here.

parentRef.description: Parent/view reference. Same character rules as an element ref, plus the reserved value `root` for the synthetic workspace root.

viewPlacement.description: Places the containing element inside another element's internal view (or the root view when parent is `root`).

position_x.description: Omitted on an existing placement: preserve its current X coordinate. New placements are laid out automatically.

position_y.description: Omitted on an existing placement: preserve its current Y coordinate. New placements are laid out automatically.

visibility_delta.description: Density/noise-gate adjustment applied to this placement relative to the parent view.

element.description: An element patch. Name is required. Omitted and empty string fields preserve existing metadata; use tld update element to clear fields. Omitted placements preserve other placements.

name.description: Human-readable element name shown on the diagram.

kind.description: Element kind/category. Free-form lowercase token used for icon and default styling (e.g. service, database, queue, cache). Defaults to `service` when created through the CLI.

description.description: Long-form description of the element's responsibility.

technology.description: Primary technology label (e.g. Go, React, Postgres).

url.description: External link to documentation, repo, or runbook.

logo_url.description: Override logo/icon URL or catalog slug. May be a relative path or a technology slug.

repo.description: Repository identifier this element lives in (e.g. an owner/name slug).

repository_id.description: Identifier of the indexed codeindex repository this element is linked to. When set, `repo`/`file_path` are resolved against that repository's local checkout.

branch.description: Repository branch associated with this element.

file_path.description: Source file path within the repo for code-linked elements. When combined with `symbol`, the CLI verifies the symbol exists.

tags.description: Free-form labels used for filtering and visual grouping.

has_view.description: Whether this element owns an internal (child) view/diagram. Defaults to false.

view_label.description: Label shown for a drill-down into this element's child view (e.g. Container, Component).

density_level.description: Noise-gate density level for this element's internal view. Higher values reveal more detail.

bypass_noise_gate.description: When true, this element is always shown regardless of the view's density level.

placements.description: Where this element appears across views. A source element placed in multiple parent views has one entry per parent.

viewRef.description: View reference: either `root` for the top-level workspace view or the ref of an element that owns a child view (has_view: true).

connector.description: A directed edge between two elements within a view.

source.description: Source element ref (tail of the edge).

target.description: Target element ref (head of the edge).

label.description: Short text shown on the edge (e.g. action or payload name).

description.description: Longer explanation of what flows across the connector.

relationship.description: Relationship/protocol category (e.g. SQL, HTTP, gRPC, pub/sub). Free-form; used for grouping and styling.

direction.description: Edge direction. Defaults to `forward` when omitted. `none` renders an undirected line. On an existing connector, omission preserves its current value.

style.description: Edge routing style. Defaults to `bezier` when omitted. On an existing connector, omission preserves its current value.

url.description: External link for the connector (e.g. a runbook or API docs).

source_handle.description: Anchor on the source node the edge attaches to.

target_handle.description: Anchor on the target node the edge attaches to.

visibility_delta.description: Density/noise-gate adjustment applied to this connector relative to its view.
